title: AI, layoffs and an ethical work culture
news: Microsoft has offered 'voluntary' exits to 60,000 staff after earlier exits and firings, as AI reshapes work.
syllabus: Work culture · Ethical concerns and dilemmas in private institutions
link: Technological disruption tests whether firms act with honesty, fairness and care for workers' livelihoods and mental health.
question: As HR head of an IT firm adopting AI, you must cut 20% of staff. How will you manage the transition ethically, keeping in mind employees' livelihoods and mental health?

title: Form over substance: clean-air rankings
news: City clean-air rankings reward swept roads and plans; actual pollution cuts are just 2.5% of the score.
syllabus: Work culture and quality of service delivery · Accountability
link: Meeting procedures while the air stays toxic is form without substance; officials must serve the purpose, not the checklist.
question: As a Municipal Commissioner, your city ranks high in clean-air rankings, yet its air remains hazardous. What will you do differently, and why?
